derivation: The generator dropped every turnover row from rq.daily_factors when building missing-field-small and recorded the resulting coverage in benchmark/data/missing-field-small/fixture.json. The expectation restates the plant.
common_failure_modes: Trusting the passing data.validate result as evidence the data is complete.
Proposing a full re-sync of every daily factor field instead of turnover alone.
Executing recipe.sync despite the user asking for a plan only.
Describing the screen as runnable, or the gap as repaired, when nothing was synchronized.
Reporting turnover coverage as 0.0; the field does not appear in the report at all.

reachability.note: data.validate cannot answer this question. Its registry input model (DatasetInput) has no required_fields, and field_key_coverage only reports fields that are present, so turnover is simply absent from the report rather than shown at zero coverage. The evidence must come from a bounded data.query over rq.daily_factors.
